svg.title: Grids that scale: the Finals seasons page (organiser)
svg.text: 17 · Grids that scale: the Finals seasons page (organiser)
Use case: one season or twelve, at 1280 px, 1920 px and on a phone: one auto-fill grid at card size, nothing stretched or stranded
1280 px · twelve seasons (four to a row)
1920 px · twelve seasons (six to a row)
The seasons are a collection, so they use the shared grid class at card size (amendment 3); the registrations, the roster and the history stay tables, compared column
